lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all tested kinds of changes (choose_path copy, finish copy, home wait_info) as each only has a single test.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to the noise-corrected measurements across all tests.

candidates.title: Choose Path Spotlight Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen layout into a high-visibility spotlight layout with animated choice cards and clear path descriptions.
candidates.why: choose_path has a huge mean time (514s) indicating users stall or get confused when choosing how to get their pet.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Adopt Your Desktop Companion
choose_path.body: Pick a classic pet companion instantly or generate a unique desktop pet from photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path screen layout while retaining path options and core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targeted choose_path step has high stall time (514s), but new screen layout requires a full release with no support mail backing.

candidates.title: Interactive Waiting Activity Screen
candidates.change: Add a new interactive minigame screen 'new_waiting_game' while the desktop pet is generating, giving users instant mini-interactions.
candidates.why: The waiting home step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, driving high drop-off before finishing onboarding.

new_waiting_game.headline: Play While Your Pet Prepares!
new_waiting_game.body: Practice feeding and playing with your digital pet companion preview.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new waiting activity screen during pet creation inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High wait time at home step causes drop-offs, but introducing a minigame requires a new screen release with only funnel evidence.

candidates.title: Guided Pet Style Selector Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a new visual styling sub-flow 'new_pet_style' right before adoption certificate creation to customize pet appearance and behavior.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.

new_pet_style.headline: Customize Pet Appearance & Traits
new_pet_style.body: Fine-tune colors and personality traits before creating your certificate.

guard.reason: Adds a valid visual customization sub-flow before adoption certificate creation.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the biggest drop (39.1% loss) and 3 support emails, making potential impact high despite needing a new sub-flow.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift
candidates.change: Reorder the sign_in screen to occur right after adoption certificate generation rather than before selecting/creating a pet.
candidates.why: 72.9% sign_in conversion shows early sign-in friction before users build emotional attachment to their chosen pet.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after adoption certificate generation is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in tackles 27.1% drop-off by deferring friction until after emotional attachment, backed by funnel data.

candidates.title: Account Sync Safeguard Sign-In Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit account sync reminder hint on sign_in explaining that logging into the wrong account resets saved pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with different credentials.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account to keep your existing desktop pet!

guard.reason: 'sign_in.components[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Progress & Time Estimator
candidates.change: Show dynamic time estimates, progress bar, and active desktop setup tips on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait time averages 2336s, causing uncertainty and user abandonments.

waiting.hint: We are preparing your desktop pet overlay. This usually takes under 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Dynamic time estimates and setup tips during an actual generation wait are permitted under Rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Home step loses 18.7% with long wait, but prior test for home wait_info showed negligible lift (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Onboarding Guide
candidates.change: Display explicit desktop interaction hints on home_intro showing how to click, move, talk to, or hide the pet on screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their new pet.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet to open controls, or drag to reposition anywhere on your desktop!

guard.reason: Displays desktop control guide hints on home_intro, which is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 35.2% of users and 3 support tickets highlight control confusion; cheap hint UI update.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Card Layout
candidates.change: Switch adoption_certificate layout to card style with official badge and confirmation components.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%) with mean duration of 1017s.

guard.reason: The 'Official Companion' badge replaces the certificate layout without providing a stamp that reads as an official adoption stamp.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Ready Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification alert and mascot welcome audio cue when home_intro completes.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on the desktop or failing to render upon setup finish.

components.text: Your pet is now active on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding completion notifications and audio cues to home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 35.2% and 3 support emails note pets missing/failing to render; notification UI fix is medium effort.

candidates.title: Clear Path Selection Incentive Copy
candidates.change: Update choose_path text to highlight instant readiness versus custom photo pet creation options.
candidates.why: High mean completion time (514s) indicates ambiguity during path selection.

choose_path.headline: Ready to Meet Your Desktop Pet?
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-play companion in seconds, or upload photos to build a unique custom pet.

guard.reason: Updates choose_path copy while maintaining both adoption options (ready-to-play and custom pet).

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change targeting 514s stall time; prior test of choose_path copy measured +2.7% relative lift.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for most kinds of changes (adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish hint, sign_in reorder) as each has only been tested once.
For home wait_info changes (2 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with one test showing no clear effect and the other triggering a guardrail rollback.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across almost all tests.
